name: Vurdalak
source:
A story about a close and at the same time distant protagonist of the PANKA universe, the one who took upon himself all the absurdity and madness of this place, of this story.
About the one who was reborn.

[Translated from [url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2223417155]Steam[/url]]
translation:
这是一个关于PANKA宇宙中一位既亲密又遥远的主角的故事，他承担了这个地方、这个故事的所有荒谬和疯狂。
关于重生的那个人。

[译自[url=https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=2223417155]Steam[/url]]
